forms.name: QTI中文Sun2018｜课堂观察记录（项目无分表单）｜初中7–9年级｜学生填写
forms.instruction: 这是一份不计分的课堂观察记录，帮助你记录自己愿意提供的课堂经历。请只围绕本次指定的同一位老师和课堂填写。每题可选“我观察到过”“我暂未观察到”或“我不确定或不便回答”，也可以跳过；不必补写细节或真实姓名。这些选项由项目自拟，记录是否观察到，不表示行为频率；本表不是原QTI五点量表，不计算八维、Agency、Communion或教师好坏。反馈的接收者、匿名及可见范围以本次既有安排为准；若可见范围不清楚，可以暂不填写。
forms.adaptation: Chinese fragments preserved with shared stem; response choices, optional/refusal policy and fixed mixed order are project adaptations, not validated QTI administration. No frequency scale or inferential equivalence.
forms.report: 仅确认已记录愿意提供的观察；不生成评分或体验分析。

forms.name: QTI中文Sun2018｜施测背景（无分表单）｜初中7–9年级｜学生填写
forms.instruction: 优先使用本次施测预置代号。不要填写真实姓名、生日或联系方式；不确定或不愿提供可跳过。
forms.sourceItems: Project-authored optional context fields, not original QTI items.
forms.report: 已记录你选择提供的施测背景信息。此表单不计分。

fixedOrder.method: Python random.Random with a fixed content-authoring seed; frozen content order, no runtime engine

rights: CC BY 4.0 article/Table4; preserve attribution and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE.md
visibility: Existing authorization and publication rules only; no automatic access to individual student answers for teachers. Do not promise anonymity absent actual delivery configuration.
combination: Optional context form plus full observation form through existing ordinary questionnaire form-template import. No SCALE item or cross-tool score.
validation: Existing services imported both forms and ordinary combination into disposable PG and read them back; database destroyed after validation. No persistent/public installation.
